applicationRepository.description: Free, 100% offline desktop app to download, restore EXIF dates & GPS, and burn in caption overlays for Snapchat Memories exports (macOS, Windows, Linux).

existingRelease.body:
## Which installer should I download?

| Operating System | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **macOS (Apple Silicon — M1 / M2 / M3 / M4)** | `SnapVault-1.0.15-macos-arm64.dmg` | Most Macs from late 2020 onward (ExifTool + FFmpeg bundled) |
| **macOS (Intel)** | `SnapVault-1.0.15-macos-x64.dmg` | Pre-2021 Intel Macs (ExifTool + FFmpeg bundled) |
| **Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)** | `SnapVault-1.0.15-windows-x64.msi` | ExifTool + FFmpeg bundled |
| **Linux (Ubuntu / Debian x86_64)** | `SnapVault-1.0.15-linux-x64.deb` | ExifTool bundled (requires `perl`); install `ffmpeg` via `apt` for video overlays |

> **Step-by-step guide & 2-minute walkthrough:** https://snapvault.naj-dev.com/tutorial

### First-launch notes (unsigned open-source builds)
- **macOS (Sequoia 15+ / Sonoma):** Drag **SnapVault** to **Applications** and try to open it once. When macOS blocks it, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** If SmartScreen displays *Windows protected your PC*, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux:** Install runtime prerequisites for metadata & video overlay compositing: `sudo apt install ffmpeg perl`.

## What's Changed

- fix: report verified release desktop commit status
- fix(release): validate version commits before updating protected main
- Add Ko-fi username to FUNDING.yml
- refactor(strings): correct, unify and extract user-facing wording
- ci: require platform builds and verify the complete iOS app
- fix(combine): preserve existing mobile outputs and cover GIF deletion
- docs(mobile): refresh the state audit and start a progress log
- feat(settings): drop the dependency card on mobile and stop it squashing
- ci(ios): link the framework instead of only compiling it
- fix(ios): surface a refused URL instead of discarding the result
- build(ios): stop Xcode skipping the Kotlin build and shipping stale code
- fix(ios): make external links open again
- fix(ios): stop the app aborting on launch with no Info.plist key
- feat(ios): burn overlays into images with CoreGraphics
- fix(combine): stop an animated GIF being replaced by one flattened frame
- test(onboarding): cover the walkthrough button now that the video exists
- ci: drop the setup-android step that broke the Linux Android job
- ci: cut runner spend without losing a check
- ci: give the Gradle wrapper a usable timeout and let it retry
- ci: authenticate setup-java in check.yml so PR runs stop hitting the rate limit
- chore(git): track the commit-msg hook that refuses AI attribution
- feat(android): make the ZIP pipeline actually run on Android
- feat(onboarding): implement first-launch onboarding flow with navigation and user guidance

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/najchris11/snapchat-memories-downloader/compare/v1.0.14...v1.0.15

## Verification
- Compare your downloaded installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt` (`shasum -a 256` on macOS/Linux or `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` in PowerShell).
- `bundled-tools-manifest.json` records exact upstream URLs, SHA-256 digests, and licenses for every bundled ExifTool and FFmpeg archive.

limits: Existing release notes and settings only; no new binary release or deployment.
